prompt.de: Was essen viele Menschen in Italien sehr gern?
prompt.en: What do lots of people in Italy love to eat?

prompt.de: Wie heisst die Hauptstadt von Italien?

prompt.en: In which city do people travel by boat instead of by car?

funFact.it: Il gondoliere sta in piedi a poppa e rema con un solo remo.

prompt.de: Welches riesige alte Gebäude steht in Rom?
prompt.en: Which huge ancient building stands in Rome?

funFact.en: Olive trees can live for more than a thousand years.
